disclaimer: Not financial or tax advice. Simplified model for Canadian vehicle swaps: economic monthly ownership cost (terminal-equity TCO), province-aware purchase taxes (including BC PST-116), EV rebates, and a reverse max-budget solve. Retained value at exit is a user assumption, not a market forecast. Excludes leases, insurer quotes, credit-score pricing, and income-tested rebate eligibility checks. Use as a sensitivity tool, not a recommendation.
author: Mohammad Miri
privacyP1: This calculator runs entirely in your browser. Your inputs are not sent to a server. Assumptions are stored locally under smc_inputs (localStorage, with a first-party cookie when the payload fits) so settings persist when you return. Use Reset to defaults to clear. No analytics or advertising trackers are used.
privacyP2: Fonts are self-hosted in the app bundle. Theme preference is stored under smc_theme. If you contact the author via GitHub, that is governed by GitHub's privacy policy.
termsP1: The site and model are provided as is, without warranty. Results are estimates for educational comparison only. Tax and rebate rules were last reviewed for {{rulesDate}}; programs change. Confirm figures with a dealer, lender, or provincial registry before deciding.
termsP2: To the fullest extent permitted by law, the authors are not liable for any loss arising from use of this tool. The open-source software is licensed under MIT (see repository).
